CFML Language Reference: Functions

QuotedValueList

Like ValueList, but every value is enclosed in single quotes, ready to drop into a SQL IN clause.

Category

Query functions

Syntax

QuotedValueList(query.column [, delimiter ])

Parameters

query.column
A column reference written literally as query name, dot, column name.
delimiter
String placed between the quoted values. The default is a comma.

Returns

The list as a string, for example 'Achebe','Alvarez'.

Usage

Inside CFQUERY, KoldFusion doubles single quotes in most expressions to protect your SQL, but it leaves the results of the SQL-building functions alone: QuotedValueList, ListQualify, PreserveSingleQuotes and the CreateODBC family. So IN (#QuotedValueList(q.LastName)#) works as written (wrapping it in PreserveSingleQuotes, as the example does, is harmless).

Apostrophes inside the values are not doubled, so a value like O'Brien breaks the generated SQL. Use it on columns such as codes and IDs where that cannot happen.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="GetDepts" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT Dept_Name FROM Departments
WHERE Dept_Name IN ('Sales', 'Training')
</CFQUERY>
<CFQUERY NAME="GetPeople" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT FirstName, LastName, Department FROM Employees
WHERE Department IN (#PreserveSingleQuotes(QuotedValueList(GetDepts.Dept_Name))#)
ORDER BY Department, LastName
</CFQUERY>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>QuotedValueList: <TT>#QuotedValueList(GetDepts.Dept_Name)#</TT></P>
</CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="GetPeople">
<TR><TD>#Department#</TD><TD>#FirstName# #LastName#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>
